name: Ritz Carlton, Grand Cayman
insider_take: The Ritz-Carlton, Grand Cayman isn't just a beachfront resort—it's your gateway to one of the world's most legendary diving destinations and the Caribbean's financial capital.
whats_special: This ultra-luxury resort sits on Seven Mile Beach, consistently ranked among the world's best beaches. The hotel features the Caribbean's first Ritz-Carlton Reserve-level spa and offers direct access to the famous Stingray City, where you can swim with gentle southern stingrays in crystal-clear shallow waters just offshore.
pro_tip: Book the Stingray City excursion through the hotel's concierge early in your stay—morning trips offer the best visibility and fewer crowds for this once-in-a-lifetime experience.
dont_miss: The Blue by Eric Lanlard restaurant for world-class oceanfront dining, and snorkeling at nearby Coral Gardens where you'll find some of the Caribbean's most pristine coral formations. The hotel's location also puts you minutes from George Town's duty-free shopping and the famous local conch fritters.
pros: Pristine Seven Mile Beach beachfront location
Legendary Ritz-Carlton service and luxury amenities
World-class spa and golf course facilities
Exceptional dining options and culinary experiences
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects high-end positioning
Remote Caribbean island location requires flight connections
